name: HMG
description: HMG, or Human Menopausal Gonadotropin, is a hormone-based compound crucial for advancing research in fertility and reproductive health. name: HCG

Ideal for studies in endocrine system balance and natural testosterone production, HCG is essential in reproductive and hormonal health exploration.

name: TESAMORELIN

Studies also explore its role in supporting recovery, regenerative processes, and overall vitality, making it a key focus in metabolism and wellness research.
